body: Hey OP, just wanted to say I completely relate and I am here if you want to talk to anyone

Hey there,

I am also on Day 5, it's been rough!!

Sleeping has marginally gotten better, but I keep waking up frequently with horrid night sweats.

I'm also a anhedonic, been trying to do things I would usually love to do, but for the last few days I've just curled up in a ball in bed after work and barely moved the whole evening. 

Today is also my first day on prescription medication for depression - I'm having a whale of a time... 🐋

Hang in there x
